recommendations: Run database migrations to create the schema: dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project src/TourManagement.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TourManagement.Web
Apply migrations: dotnet ef database update --project src/TourManagement.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TourManagement.Web
Update connection string in appsettings.json to match your environment
Run integration tests to verify functionality
Review and customize authentication settings as needed
Add authorization policies for admin vs user roles
Implement file upload functionality for tour pictures
Run the application: dotnet run --project src/TourManagement.Web
